meta.description: Sixteen practice areas covering OHADA, corporate, finance, regulatory, dispute resolution and private client matters.

title: Expertise
lead: Sixteen practice areas spanning the OHADA Uniform Acts and Cameroonian domestic law.

items.title: Corporate, Commercial & OHADA Law
items.description: Company formation, corporate governance and commercial contracting under the OHADA Uniform Acts.

items.title: Mergers & Acquisitions
items.description: Advice on the structuring, negotiation and completion of acquisitions and business combinations.

items.title: Banking, Finance & Project Finance
items.description: Lending, security and project finance structures for banks, lenders and borrowers.

items.title: Energy, Infrastructure & Natural Resources
items.description: Regulatory and transactional advice across the energy, infrastructure and natural resources sectors.

items.title: Tax, Customs & Foreign Exchange
items.description: Guidance on tax, customs duties and foreign exchange control matters affecting cross-border business.

items.title: Regulatory, Competition & Public Law
items.description: Advice on regulatory compliance, competition law and public law matters.

items.title: Compliance & Investigations
items.description: Compliance frameworks and internal investigations, informed by international anti-bribery standards.

items.title: Data Protection, Technology & Digital Business
items.description: Advice on data protection, technology contracts and digital business models.

items.title: Employment, Benefits & Immigration
items.description: Employment relationships, staff benefits and immigration matters for employers.

items.title: Litigation, Arbitration & ADR
items.description: Representation before Cameroonian courts and in arbitration and other dispute resolution forums.

items.title: Debt Recovery, Restructuring & Insolvency
items.description: Debt recovery, restructuring and insolvency proceedings under OHADA law.

items.title: Intellectual Property
items.description: Protection and enforcement of trademarks, patents and other intellectual property rights.

items.title: Real Estate, Construction & Land
items.description: Land tenure, real estate transactions and construction matters.

items.title: Environment, Health & Safety and ESG
items.description: Environmental, health and safety compliance and ESG-related advisory work.

items.title: Maritime, Aviation, Transport & Logistics
items.description: Advice for operators and businesses across maritime, aviation, transport and logistics.

items.title: Private Client, Family & Succession
items.description: Personal legal matters including family and succession planning for private clients.
